steps.path: Click the model chip in the status bar
steps.headline: Model menu with your changes — keep?
steps.changed: For a Claude Code session the search box is gone: all four Claude models are always listed (small to large: Haiku, Sonnet, Opus, Fable). "Manage models…" is now the list's last row, lined up with the model names, instead of a separate footer at the bottom.
steps.notice: Sessions on other models (local or OpenRouter) keep the search box, since their lists can be long. The current model keeps its light tint instead of moving to the top.
